---
title: "Popularity of the Name Marley Over Time"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

baby_names <- read_csv(
  "ssa-baby-names.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    year = col_integer(),
    name = col_character(),
    sex = col_character(),
    count = col_integer()
  )
)

marley <- baby_names |>
  filter(name == "Marley", sex %in% c("M", "F")) |>
  select(year, sex, count)

marley_by_year <- expand_grid(
  year = seq(min(baby_names$year), max(baby_names$year)),
  sex = c("M", "F")
) |>
  left_join(marley, by = c("year", "sex"))

ggplot(marley_by_year, aes(x = year, y = count, color = sex, group = sex)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Sex",
    values = c("M" = "#2878B5", "F" = "#D64F8B"),
    labels = c("M" = "Male", "F" = "Female")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name Marley Over Time",
    subtitle = "Gaps indicate years without a published Marley count; they are not zeroes.",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of babies named Marley"
  )
```
